attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or or Wisdom or Divine 11
attributes.name: Control Weather
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 2d8 to any check by a character on a ship, or to evade a bane that has the Weather trait, or to banish a displayed card that has the Weather trait.

At the end of the turn, discard this card to move any character.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 13 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
